title: Space/set addCategories rejects entries without position or channelIds
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (5630c10) §Space/set addCategories: 'Each entry: name (String), optional position (UnsignedInt) and channelIds (String[]). Server assigns ULIDs.' crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs parse_structural_entries parses each entry as jmap_chat_types::Category, whose position (u64) and channel_ids (Vec<Id>) are required serde fields, so an entry omitting either is rejected with invalidProperties. jmap-chat-client SpaceAddCategoryInput omits both when None (its rustdoc says 'None lets the server append'), so SpaceAddCategoryInput::new(name) alone fails against the reference server. The draft does not define the default position; decide one (e.g. append after max existing position) and record it. channelIds absent should mean empty. Found while fixing JMAP-yt1w.14.
